_comment: 金刚宠 · Brand v3 design tokens (2026-11-02) · 暖陶橙. 5 primary + 4 functional. Flat design — no neumorphic shadows, no glow, no decorative gradients.

cream.name: 奶油白
cream.use: 松弛的容器 — light-mode canvas, 90% of screen

navy.name: 藏蓝
navy.use: 专业与信任 — primary color, body text, headers, dark-mode canvas

gold.name: 金刚金
gold.use: 克制的精致 — supporting color, icons, dividers, secondary CTA

ink.name: 近黑
ink.use: 仪式与重心 — display type, dark surfaces, ceremony moments

terracotta.name: 暖陶橙
terracotta.use: 温暖·亲切·陪伴 — accent, 限定活动 badges, 会员升级 ribbons
terracotta.ratio: 常规 ≤8% · 会员升级/限定活动 10–12%

surface.name: 卡片面
surface.use: Flat card surface on cream canvas (replaces v2 neumorphic elevation)

success.name: 成功绿
success.use: 成功 / 完成 / 正常

info.name: 链接蓝
info.use: 链接 / 交互 / 重点

mode_mapping._note: Same functional colours in both modes — status recognition never changes.

logo._note: FIXED ASSET — never redraw, substitute or 'improve' the logo. Replace the source file and re-derive the PNGs instead.

_migration_notes: v3 REPLACES the v2 neumorphic system. Elevation is now flat: white surface on cream canvas, hairline borders only.
Dark mode canvas is 藏蓝 #1B3A5C in v3 (was iOS gray #1C1C1E in v2).
v3 functional colours are all-new: #22C55E / #F59E0B / #EF4444 / #2563EB (v2 used muted #2E7D32 / #E67E22 / #C62828 / #0A66C2).
暖陶橙 #C97B5A is NEW — v2 had no warm accent. Use ≤8%, 10-12% for 会员升级 / 限定活动 only.
Tailwind namespace is now `brand-v3-*`. The old `brand-v2-*` and `neumo-*` sets are deprecated aliases kept for one release.
